title: [Lean] Verify counted signed addition and marked zero padding
body:
## Result and coverage

Explicit author-checked context: upstream main 0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea; kappa = 836330098538459/500000000000000000 = 0.001672660197076918. These generic modules change no selected numerical bound.

This completed chunk contains two independently checked finite-word components:
- SequentialBitAddition: signed ripple arithmetic, two executed sign columns, exactly 11n+10 transitions in the stated boundary-observing three-track model, returned head, unchanged inputs and cleared scratch.
- MarkedZeroPadding: an explicit symbol-marked three-tape padding/copy machine, exactly 6(d+n)+14 transitions, at most 2(d+n)+6 represented tape cells at every prefix, plus one Boolean register and finite control. It writes output markers and handles empty inputs.

Finite coverage: parameterized finite words and supplied unary padding lengths, rather than a selected literal census.
Conditional-interface coverage: supplied input/marker/unary-control formats and the adder's boundary-observing entrance model remain explicit. Their layouts differ; a paid zip/sign-column builder is still required before physical sequential composition. These machines clear prescribed scratch/output; they do not restore arbitrary prior output.
Full-theorem coverage: no complete selected allocator, encoding, all-size integer multiplication, or final multiplication/runtime bound is proved.

## Evidence and reproduction

Accepted sources are unchanged: SequentialBitAddition SHA256 7729e218143ac20dac17ca3c5ecd68b784d1d1c0b70fd2f0e4d13b8961e26c92 and MarkedZeroPadding SHA256 bd289c3ec5857e8dfd74a6e1138e8493c49f37bdbb83c4d6912ac902a879f302. Existing native checks took 3.243308743 and 4.286828551 seconds. All 24 probes and four full printed types received independent review; the adder retains one accepted unnecessarySimpa style warning, padding has none.

REPRODUCE.md gives source-hash-checked commands for Lean 4.21.0 and Mathlib 308445d7985027f538e281e18df29ca16ede2ba3. It reuses the two public XOR modules at PR1840 exact head 3f1b0641d5866f9d0b6cdd8e46db416fed6c5645 in caller scratch, without copying their source into this package. Existing receipts are provenance, not a relocated replay. No additional local CI preflight was run for publication. CI will be inspected after submission; generic repository checks alone do not establish a fresh Lean replay.

## Attribution and duplicate comparison

James Chang with OpenAI assistance, Apache-2.0; Lean/Mathlib and the public XOR prerequisites retain their attribution. PR64/511/519/565 provide earlier counting, allocation, trimming and copying interfaces; the bounded exact-source comparison found no equivalent pair of these signed addition and marked-padding implementations. PR1840 is an explicit reused dependency. This claims the scoped implementation and checked bounds, not first-ever arithmetic or optimality. The later marked-adder refinement and layout builder are intentionally separate chunks.
